skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Automate Twitter/X posting, media sharing, engagement, direct messages, follows, and profile lookup through the inference.sh CLI.
skill.summary: Run approved Twitter/X automation workflows through inference.sh CLI apps.
skill.author: skillssh

security_audit.summary: Several external-command alerts are Markdown syntax false positives, but multiple examples intentionally run infsh commands that can post, engage, send DMs, delete posts, or install related skills. Most hardcoded URL alerts are documentation references; the remote image is a low-risk external fetch. No prompt injection or secret exfiltration evidence was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation before posting, liking, retweeting, sending DMs, following users, or deleting posts. Show exact text, recipients, usernames, and IDs first.
Disclose that infsh commands contact inference.sh, X, and media-generation apps. Recommend authenticating only in trusted environments.
Separate npx installation commands from the core workflow and instruct users to inspect the source before installing extra skills.
Use trusted marketplace-hosted media or omit the external image to avoid automatic third-party fetches when documentation is rendered.

content.value_statement: Manual Twitter/X posting and engagement can slow campaign work. This skill uses inference.sh CLI apps to run approved posting, media, and engagement tasks.
actual_capabilities: Posts text updates through the x/post-tweet app.
Creates posts with media URLs through the x/post-create app.
Likes, retweets, deletes, and retrieves posts by ID.
Sends direct messages and follows users through X apps.
Combines generated image or video outputs with X posting workflows.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and a completed login.
Requires a configured X integration with the needed permissions.
Does not provide a built-in approval workflow before account actions.
Media posts require an accessible media URL from another source.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Updates
use_cases.description: Post prepared campaign messages or announcements to a connected Twitter/X account.

use_cases.title: Share Launch Media
use_cases.description: Create posts that combine approved copy with image or video URLs from generation workflows.

use_cases.title: Manage Targeted Engagement
use_cases.description: Like, retweet, follow, or message specified accounts when IDs and recipients are approved.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Text Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use twitter-automation to post this approved text to X: [approved text]. Confirm the account before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an X post with this approved caption and media URL: [caption] [media URL]. Verify the media URL first.

prompt_templates.title: Engage With Specific Posts
prompt_templates.prompt: Like and retweet these approved post IDs: [post IDs]. Show the IDs and ask for confirmation before action.

prompt_templates.title: Generate and Publish Campaign Media
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate media from this prompt, review the returned asset URL, then create an approved X post with this caption: [caption].

output_examples.input: Post this approved launch message to X.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares the tweet, asks for final approval, runs the posting app, and returns the resulting post status.

output_examples.input: Share this approved caption with a hosted image URL.
output_examples.output: The skill verifies the media URL, creates a media post through inference.sh, and reports whether the post succeeded.

output_examples.input: Like and retweet these approved post IDs.
output_examples.output: The skill lists the target IDs, waits for confirmation, runs the engagement actions, and summarizes each result.

best_practices: Confirm the connected X account before every posting or engagement command.
Review exact text, media URLs, recipients, usernames, and post IDs before running actions.
Use least-privilege X integration permissions when possible.
anti_patterns: Do not automate likes, follows, retweets, or DMs without explicit user approval.
Do not post generated media before a human reviews the final asset URL.
Do not run optional skill installation commands without inspecting the source.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to Twitter/X?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses inference.sh X apps to post or engage after the CLI and integration are configured.

faq.question: Does it require an external account?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires an inference.sh login and a configured X integration.

faq.question: Can it post media?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create posts that reference an accessible media URL.

faq.question: Can it send direct messages?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented apps include direct message sending to a specified recipient.

faq.question: Does it include scheduling?
faq.answer: The description mentions scheduling, but the visible examples focus on immediate CLI actions.

faq.question: Is human approval recommended?
faq.answer: Yes. Approval is recommended before any post, message, follow, delete, like, or retweet action.
